# Nob End Run Club

> A fun and friendly social running club based around Nob End Nature Reserve, Little Lever, Bolton, Greater Manchester, UK. All abilities welcome, beginners encouraged.

## Weekly schedule
- Wednesday track: Leverhulme Park athletics track, Bolton. Meet 7:50pm, run 8pm for about an hour.
- Wednesday road/trail run (non-track weeks): around 7:30pm, start point varies weekly, usually finishes at a pub.
- Sunday: road, trail or canal run around Nob End / Little Lever / Bolton, followed by coffee. Start point and time posted weekly.
